families.label: Aerial
families.definition: How many aerial duels the player wins per 90: involvement in the air, not the share won.

families.label: Carrying & dribbling
families.definition: How often the player carries the ball forward and into the box, per 90: volume, not dribbling success.

families.label: Creation
families.definition: How many open-play passes per 90 lead to a shot: volume of chances made, not their quality.

families.label: Defending
families.withheld_short: not shown to be free of team-possession effects
families.withheld_full: not shown to be free of team-possession effects Defending scores are withheld: these metrics are not shown to be free of team-possession effects. This is not a finding about the player.

families.label: Goal threat
families.definition: How many non-penalty shots the player takes per 90: volume, not finishing.

families.label: Passing
families.withheld_short: rests on long pass completion alone
families.withheld_full: rests on long pass completion alone, which is not shown to follow the player across clubs; xPass deferred until after launch

families.label: Progressive passing
families.definition: How often the player passes the ball forward and into the box, per 90: volume, not pass accuracy.
